name: kevcal
description: Turns a photo, screenshot or PDF of anything with dates on it into calendar events.

scripts.build:tools: swiftc -O -o bin/kevcal-ocr tools/ocr.swift && swiftc -O -o bin/kevcal-samples tools/make-samples.swift
scripts.test: node test/verify.test.js && node test/readers.test.js && node test/run.js
